protocol.lomo: leave-one-model-out over the five model families
protocol.cross_group: train: G1/G2 queries; test: independently worded G3_instruction queries (unseen tasks)
protocol.memory_filter: only tool calls inside task-valid trajectories enter success memory
protocol.extractor_learning: per parameter name, pick the best-supported deterministic extractor (ISO dates, month-years, years, quoted keywords, numbers, countries) from successful training calls; unseen parameter names fall back to name-based extractor selection
repair_strategies: deterministic schema rules (function-name resolution, drop/rename args, schema defaults, type coercion)
schema default completion when the error names no parameters (unverified proposal)

verification.schema_validity: every repaired call must satisfy the agent-visible schema
verification.value_agreement: repaired parameter values equal a recorded successful invocation of the same task/function
verification.cache_verification: repaired call replayed against the released real-response cache (subset only)

key_findings: Instance-level memory does not transfer to unseen task sets (0% in the previous artifact); learned task-text extractors raise cross-task repair coverage to 75%, with 27/76 (35.5%) carrying verified parameter values.

The learned text extractors achieved 39/39 (100%) value agreement across both held-out protocols (12/12 cross-model + 27/27 cross-group): the extracted dates/keywords/years are exactly the values that worked in recorded runs.
All 530 LOMO repairs and all 57 cross-group repairs are schema-valid; cache verification found 0 regressions (48 recoveries, 0 still-error).
Schema-default completion contributes many proposals (30 in cross-group) but zero value agreement - it is reported as an unverified heuristic, not counted as quality evidence.
Server-side/transient errors (96 across the dataset) remain unrepairable offline; they are classified as retryable and are the target of the live-demo middleware.
limitations: Offline replay only: no live API/tool execution in this artifact.
The released response cache covers reference-solution inputs only (final-attempt replay hit rate 51.6%); repaired calls that miss the cache cannot be verified (cache_miss=482 in LOMO).
Value agreement is only checkable when some model solved the same task instance; it is a strict lower bound on verified repairs.
Schema-default completion is a proposal, not verified evidence.
Server-side/transient errors are not repaired deterministically offline.
Single repair direction: the middleware does not modify tool implementations or agent prompts in this artifact.
